codeReview.summary: Implementation covers all expected behaviors. The cancellation flow (DELETE endpoint, K8s Job deletion, DB status update) already existed in the codebase. The new OrphanCleaner service adds orphaned Job detection and cleanup for cases where evaluations are deleted or in terminal states with active Jobs. Code quality is good with proper error handling, context propagation, and structured logging.

issues.description: Resource cleanup in cleanupRelatedResources uses hardcoded naming convention 'eval-config-{evalID}' and 'eval-secret-{evalID}'. Consider using constants or deriving names from existing config/secret manager functions to avoid naming drift if implementation changes.
